text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's New Year's Day. I thought we'd hold
a
meeting in anticipation of her
upcoming classic
year, when the real
races start, but...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Athbhliain faoi mhaise duit! Happy New
Year! ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, these? I've just been doing a little
shopping!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Isn't New Year's in Japan just
delightful?! I'd
heard stories, but
everything is truly lively!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
They call these lucky bags, correct?
There's
happiness packed right inside
each one! What a
splendid custom. ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Perhaps a little too much happiness.
They are
rather heavy.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Now, I believe we had a meeting
scheduled,
correct? We'll be discussing
my upcoming Triple
Tiara tour and how
to prepare for the... Queen
Elizabeth II...
Cup...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'm just going to go out there and run
with
everything I have! Do you have
anything to add?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Really?! That's it? You wrapped that up
so
wonderfully fast!
choice_data_list_en: ...Let's give it our all this year, too! That is all!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Then it's time to open these lucky
bags! ♪ Yay! ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'm especially intrigued by these three.
Which
should I open, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I check the bags that Fine Motion is
pointing at.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Excellent choice! Purchasing that one
proved
incredibly difficult.
choice_data_list: よりどりパン詰め合わせ福袋
choice_data_list_en: Limited lucky bags for the first 10 customers.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I must be blessed with great luck,
though, as I got
the last one. Now, let's
see what we've got here...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh? It's a pair of shoes!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
From the bag emerges a pair of
children's shoes
that light up as you
walk.
choice_data_list: しかも子ども用じゃないか……？
しかも子ども用じゃない……？

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, so that's why there were so many
parents
lined up with their children!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hmmm, these light-up shoes are wonderful... but as much as I like them, it is clear who these should go to.

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
Wow! They're so cool!
Thanks so much!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I'm so glad you like them. ♪ Now
how
about you put on those new shoes
and race me?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After New Year's, Fine Motion buys
more shoes
and donates them to the
local welfare facility for
children in need.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what kind of bread is inside.
How
exciting! ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh! I have a splendid idea...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Simply scrumptious! ♪ The best way to
enjoy
bread is at a picnic!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer, is that a red bean bun? It
looks
delicious!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Fine Motion and I have a
relaxing time
eating all kinds of bread.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hehe, that one sounds rather fun.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Let's see what we have here...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Some kind of... large paper fan?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh, is this a famous item?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I don't really understand, but I do have
this urge
to wave it around!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Like this, perhaps... Hehe. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...There's no way she could have known
the
dance, but Fine Motion somehow
manages to do
it just right by pure
instinct.
